name: – Aurore Lalucq – Commission proposal to the Council
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive amending Directive 2006/112/EC as regards the electronic value added tax exemption certificate
part_text:
The European Parliament approves a plan to replace the paper certificate used to claim exemption from value added tax with an electronic version. The certificate is used by diplomats, international bodies and armed forces taking part in common defence. Moving online cuts paperwork and costs for authorities and users. The rules on who qualifies for the exemption stay the same. Parliament also asks the Council to consult it again if the text changes substantially.

- The paper tax exemption certificate becomes electronic; the exemptions themselves do not change.
- It affects diplomats, international bodies and armed forces, plus national tax authorities.
- Parliament approved the plan; the Council of ministers must now decide.
